name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
description: Fastest Claude model, optimized for speed and cost efficiency.
longDescription: Claude 3.5 Haiku is Anthropic's fastest and most affordable model. Despite its speed, it offers intelligence comparable to Claude 3 Opus. Ideal for high-volume, latency-sensitive applications requiring reliable quality.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
message = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-3-5-haiku-20241022",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(message.content[0].text)
